title: Power Apps: modern, refreshed look reaches embedded model-driven apps on the semiannual channel
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout facts, licensing requirement and environment release-channel controls are supported. Add the source for the no-data-or-permissions-impact statement, and remove the checklist instruction to inspect app and user overrides unless those controls are represented in the table.

claims.claim: This is a Power Apps change for model-driven apps.
claims.quote: "products": ["Power Apps"]; Applies to Model-driven apps

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Scope; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The refresh extends consistent Fluent styling and interaction patterns to model-driven app content embedded in another host.
claims.quote: Extends the modern, refreshed look to embedded app experiences so model-driven app content retains consistent Fluent styling and interaction patterns when it appears inside another host.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Only SVG custom icons are supported in navigation with the modern look.
claims.quote: Only SVG icons are supported. If you use other formats such as PNG, the navigation doesn't display them and a default icon appears instead.

claims.claim: Model-driven apps are premium apps by default.
claims.quote: Model-driven apps use Dataverse and are premium apps by default.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Every user running a model-driven app needs a license providing Power Apps premium use rights.
claims.quote: Every user who runs a model-driven app needs a license that provides Power Apps premium use rights.

claims.claim: The visual refresh is included within the entitlement already needed to run model-driven apps.
claims.quote: Every user who runs a model-driven app needs a license that provides Power Apps premium use rights.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Microsoft names no license, price or meter specific to this visual refresh.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps modern refreshed look model-driven embedded apps visual refresh licensing price meter. Opened modern-fluent-design and powerapps-licensing-faq; no refresh-specific entitlement, price or meter found.

claims.claim: The licensing FAQ links to the Power Platform Licensing Guide for the complete current list of qualifying licenses.
claims.quote: For the complete and current list of qualifying licenses that provide premium Power Apps use rights, refer to the Microsoft Power Platform Licensing Guide.

claims.claim: The semi-annual channel enables GA-ready features in April and October.
claims.quote: The semi-annual channel turns on generally available (GA) ready features twice a year, in April and October.

claims.claim: Semi-annual builds roll out gradually by region over successive weeks, so environments receive features with their region's build rather than on one universal date.
claims.quote: Because builds roll out to the region groups over successive weekends, the date an environment receives a given build depends on its region group.

claims.claim: Channel checks prioritize the URL override, then the user override, then a non-Auto app channel, then a non-Auto environment channel.
claims.quote:
1. URL override.
2. User channel override.
3. App release channel value other than Auto (for example, Monthly, Semi-annual).
4. Environment release channel value other than Auto (for example, Monthly, Semi-annual).

claims.claim: The environment channel control is at Power Platform admin center > Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Product > Behavior > Release channel > Model-driven app release channel.
claims.quote:
select Manage. ... select Environments. ... select an environment. ... select Settings. ... Expand Product, and then select Behavior.
Release channel
Model-driven app release channel

claims.claim: PATCH /organizations(<organizationid>) updates the Organization record and can set the environment channel through releasechannel.
claims.quote:
Update Event: True | PATCH /organizations(organizationid)
Writable columns/attributes ... ReleaseChannel
LogicalName | releasechannel

claims.claim: The request-body property releasechannel accepts 3 for Semi-annual channel.
claims.quote:
LogicalName | releasechannel
ReleaseChannel Choices/Options
3 | Semi-annual channel

claims.claim: Changing environment behavior settings requires the System Administrator security role or equivalent permissions.
claims.quote: Make sure you have the System Administrator security role or equivalent permissions to update the settings.

claims.claim: The environment release channel controls when model-driven app features arrive, subject to overrides, and is not a switch specific to this visual refresh.
claims.quote: You can control how often the users in your organization get these new features by specifying the release channel. ... The release channel settings described in this article apply to model-driven apps.

claims.claim: In Power Platform environments, an Auto app channel uses Monthly regardless of the environment channel.
claims.quote: Model-driven apps in Power Platform environments use Monthly when the app release channel is Auto regardless of the environment release channel. All model-driven apps in Power Platform environments need to set the app release channel explicitly.

claims.claim: Makers can set the app channel through the app designer or the Solutions area.
claims.quote: Use the app channel to override the release channel for a model-driven app by using Power Apps app designer or the Solutions area.

claims.claim: The modern-look page says admins can turn off the New Look with the New look for model driven apps app setting.
claims.quote: Admins can turn off the New Look for all users by updating the New look for model driven apps app setting.

claims.claim: Neither the modern-look page nor the app-settings page explicitly specifies whether the old New Look setting covers this embedded-host enablement.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps modern refreshed look embedded model-driven apps semiannual 2609.3 embedded host New look setting. Read modern-fluent-design and app-properties; neither specifies this setting's behavior for embedded-host enablement.

claims.claim: Learn says the modern-look change does not affect data or permissions.
claims.quote: There is no impact on app logic, data, or permissions.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/important-changes-coming#deprecation-of-the-classic-look-for-model-driven-apps to sources for the risk rationale's statement that Learn says the modern look does not change data or permissions.
